scope: Same-Round2 source/theory review only; no candidate execution, payload reading, new experiment or scientific outcome.
verdict: Support a prospective minimal B/C/D-before-GU phase-order amendment; reject the proposed Boolean NL gate and universal dominance claims.

capacity_check.hypothetical_scope: Full Deep 26x64 fixed independent NL operators, not the actual fitted eight-op intervention and not every legal placement.
capacity_check.common_geometry_correction: Gemini's 34,085,664 B does not close the current full-H tree selector. P128 plus 32 leaf means plus 31 full-H normals alone is 40,681,472 B across 26 layers, before 6,448 B thresholds and other metadata. Exact deployed packing must be explicit; this is not a lower bound on every alternative tree encoding.
capacity_check.permitted_conclusion: The stated fully pinned, independent FP32-GU/W8-Down representation exceeds 8e9 B before non-FFN state. Its exclusion under 8GiB still requires a closed inclusive ledger. The asserted compulsory non-FFN >=1.53GB, the 6.36GB hybrid fit and the 5.79GB D fit are not independently established by these formulas.
capacity_check.rejected_conclusion: All-host infeasibility does not prove NL8 can NEVER be competitive: partial residency, hot Down caching, streamed operators, finite eight-op scope, CPU work and joint scheduling remain material. Whole-bank extrapolations are prospective hypotheses, not quality-validated full models.

useful_controls_to_make_explicit: B_FlashGU_HostDown, hot-GU cache and other legal B placements: count ordinary GU sensing/commands, output ABI, per-expert readiness, host activation/A8/Down, shared-branch contention and inclusive residency. Removing a private Down flash phase is useful, not free. Current software arithmetic does not establish stock AiF bitwise equivalence or an exact all-routed B implementation.

Same C bank with cache plus ordinary weight loading and CPU execution: give identical capacity and legal cohort/cache schedules. This is a hardware-necessity control without a new numerical fit. Raw NAND tR plus PCIe payload division is not validated commodity-NVMe latency; include FTL/controller/ECC/queueing, scales and other transferred bytes, DMA/backpressure and CPU work.
mathematical_corrections: Overflow-free exact integer partial sums can be reordered. FP32 operations are not associative; preserve dot casting, scale multiplication, biases, A8 barriers and slot-alpha accumulation. Neither stock nor modified AiF arithmetic ABI is established by this algebra alone.

Do not add two standalone eight-core CPU service times as a universal lower bound. Shared and routed work can partition cores or overlap; use joint resource work and a feasible dependency schedule. Flash assistance also consumes host resources. OLM having no shared expert does not itself expose every microsecond of flash latency.
86.4GB/s is the AiF-paper/configuration parameter; Intel ARK's advertised maximum is 89.6GB/s. Neither is sustained bandwidth. EPYC AVX2 timing does not establish best i9/VEX-VNNI performance.

root_reported_secondary_D_context.provenance: Root message reporting a separate post-hoc development audit of already closed PG16 outputs; no result payload reread by this review.
root_reported_secondary_D_context.interpretation: Both upper endpoints are below ln(1.02), strengthening the practical case for measuring existing B/C/D first. This is not fresh confirmation, strict quality Pareto dominance, all-routed coverage, or an update to the original Stage0/1 comparison families.

minimal_prospective_amendment: Freeze phase-order and release semantics before actual new timing outcomes: existing B/C/D numeric checks plus direct benchmark and capacity/cost windows first; NL GU/FIT/quality remain separately gated. Source implementation can proceed in parallel.

Keep the same PGTRAIN-only 32 rows, first-four numeric checks, fixed functions/threads/cache conditions and total benchmark budget; splitting phases must not duplicate the 1,200-second BENCH allowance. No new fits, ranks, grids or heldout data are implied.
Omit the optional earliest-layer perturbation preflight until that coverage extension is authorized.

A pre-GU scientific negative needs a validated feasible matched-quality baseline and a closed best-legal optimistic candidate whole-DAG bound under the same budgets. Otherwise the result is a conditional cost window. Root may defer costly GU work for resource prioritization, but that is not NL failure or Round2 failure.

Do not require D to fail quality against C, and do not treat synthetic/zero NL buffers as an actual quality-matched deployment. Such buffers may exercise different zero-map shortcuts and cache behavior. If no scoped dominance certificate emerges, the fixed NL fit remains a legitimate mechanism control.
release: Conceptual approval of this phase-order change only, contingent on an explicit amendment and exact source/READY review. No payload, GU query, benchmark, quality run, new round or TEST authorization.
